احتشيتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَيْتُنَّ (iḥtašaytunna) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اُحْتُشِيتُنَّ (uḥtušītunna) /uħ.tu.ʃiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
